title: Alien Arithmetic: neighbouring values and aliquot dynamics of the prime shift map
description: Research notes, code, data and Lean 4 proofs on the prime shift map sigma (OEIS A003961): structural theorems, density of sigma(n+1) > sigma(n), equidistribution mod q, shift twins sigma(n+1) = sigma(n) + 2 up to 10^11, and aliquot-type dynamics of sigma(n) - n.
